name: Nationality by Marriage -- Foreign Wife of an Omani Husband

requirements.blocker_text: Available only to a foreign woman married to an Omani man -- Oman's Nationality Law does not provide an equivalent path for a foreign man married to an Omani woman.
At least 10 years of marriage to the Omani husband.
requirements.fix_path: Remain married to the Omani husband for at least 10 years.

requirements.blocker_text: Must have a child with the Omani husband.
A widow or divorcee of an Omani husband may apply after 15 years of continuous residence in Oman, with Arabic proficiency, single (unmarried) status, and having a child from the marriage.

sources.title: Decree.om -- Omani-law commentary blog: foreign-wife-of-Omani-husband route (10-year marriage, child, Arabic), separate widow/divorcee route (15-year continuous residence, Arabic, single status, child), both under Royal Decree 38/2014, no equivalent route described for a foreign husband of an Omani wife

Commoner Law -- corroborates a 10-15 year marriage-based route for foreign wives of Omani men, no equivalent for foreign husbands of Omani women, and confirms Oman does not permit dual nationality (renunciation of prior citizenship required)
